## Overview
Live tests for Birko.Data.EventSourcing.RavenDB. They run the shared event store contract
(`tests/Shared/EventSourcing/EventStoreContract.cs`, TASK-995) on `RavenDBEventStore`, obtained the way an
application does: `factory.GetEventStore(o => o.AddRavenDB())`.

## Project Location
`tests/Birko.Data.EventSourcing.RavenDB.Tests/`

## Test Framework
xUnit + FluentAssertions

## Scope & conventions
- Live only, gated on `BIRKO_RAVEN_URL`. Without it every test reports SKIPPED, and `BIRKO_REQUIRE_LIVE` turns that into a
  failure. The Docker server is `ravendb/ravendb`.
- Each test class instance uses its own database (`birko-task995-<guid>`) and deletes it on dispose.
- `NewStoreAsync()` builds a new factory each call, so the concurrency tests race two clients, not one object.

## Coverage
- `RavenDBEventStoreContractTests`:
  - the 9 contract tests: order and fields, version ranges, the empty aggregate, the current version straight after an
    append, a taken version, a conflicting batch keeping nothing, a batch holding one version twice, null and empty
    input, and DraCode's two writers;
  - the override is chosen for a RavenDB factory, and the default store is answered without it.
